You are reverse-engineering /workspace/executable (tui-journal 0.16.1, a Rust TUI journal app)
by BLACK-BOX OBSERVATION ONLY.

ABSOLUTE RULES (violating = task failure):
- NEVER decompile/disassemble/objdump/nm/strings/gdb/strace/ltrace the executable.
- NEVER search the web or fetch source code. No network anyway.
- ONLY run it and observe stdout/stderr/exit codes/files it writes/TUI screens.

TOOLS AVAILABLE TO YOU:
- /workspace/explore/tj.py : tmux-based TUI driver. Read /workspace/explore/README.md first.
  Usage: /workspace/explore/tj.py --sess UNIQ --home /tmp/h_UNIQ [--cols N] [--rows N] [--args "..."] KEYS...
  KEYS: literal text typed as-is; "^Name" = tmux key name (^Enter ^Escape ^Tab ^BTab ^Down ^Up ^C-s ^C-l ^Space ^BSpace);
        "@cap" capture plain screen, "@capE" capture WITH ANSI color escapes, "@s0.5" sleep.
  You MUST use a UNIQUE --sess and --home (include your area name) so parallel agents don't collide.
- Plain Bash for non-TUI invocations: HOME=/tmp/xxx /workspace/executable ...
- python3 available (sqlite3 module included). No cargo network.

Note: running the executable with no tty gives "Error: No such device or address (os error 6)".
Always use tj.py for TUI work.

WRITE YOUR FINDINGS to the exact file path given below, in Markdown.
Be EXTREMELY precise and literal: paste exact strings, exact byte output, exact screen captures
inside fenced code blocks, exact exit codes. A different engineer must be able to reimplement
byte-identical behavior from your notes ALONE without re-running the binary.
Prefer raw transcripts over prose summaries. Do not speculate; mark unknowns as UNKNOWN.


## YOUR AREA: TUI filter popup, sort popup, fuzzy find

Fully map filter ('f'), sort ('o'), and fuzzy find (find the key — try '/', Ctrl-f, 'F').
- FILTER popup: exact layout/title/size, all fields and controls (title text? tags multi-select list? priority? date range?), how tags are listed and toggled, keys (Tab, Space, Enter, Esc, arrows, 'a' select-all?, 'c' clear?), the confirm/cancel affordance, and exactly how an active filter is indicated on the main screen afterwards (title suffix? footer?). How to clear the filter.
- SORT popup: exact layout, the list of sortable fields and their order, ascending/descending toggle key and indicator, multi-level sort? keys to reorder criteria, apply/cancel keys, and how sorting is reflected. Default sort order of the list.
- FUZZY FIND: discover the key from the help popup (Global tab) first. Then map: prompt rendering, incremental matching behavior, whether it matches title only or content/tags too, case sensitivity, highlight of matched chars (@capE), navigation keys, Enter behavior, Esc behavior, empty query, no-match rendering text.
- Capture the complete Help popup text for ALL tabs (Global, Editor, Multi-Select) by scrolling to the very bottom — every row, verbatim, with exact column positions. Also record how the tabs are switched and the scroll keys, and the help popup at different terminal sizes.

## OUTPUT
Write your notes to: /workspace/explore/notes/tui-filter-sort-fuzzy.md
Use many fenced code blocks with verbatim transcripts. Aim for a thorough, long document.
Then return the structured summary.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create entries in a fresh HOME. Title only + tags; default date."""
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/explore")
from tj import Tj

HOME = sys.argv[1]
SESS = sys.argv[2]
ARGS = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ""

t = Tj(home=HOME, cols=120, rows=40, sess=SESS, args=ARGS)

ENTRIES = [
    ("Alpha Entry", "1", "work", "Alpha content."),
    ("Beta Entry",  "2", "home", "Beta content."),
    ("Gamma Entry", "",  "",     "Gamma content."),
]

for (title, prio, tags, content) in ENTRIES:
    t.send("n")
    t.send(title)
    t.send("^Tab")   # date
    t.send("^Tab")   # priority
    if prio:
        t.send(prio)
    t.send("^Tab")   # tags
    if tags:
        t.send(tags)
    t.send("^Enter")
    time.sleep(0.5)
    print("--- after create", title)
    print(t.cap())
    t.send("^Enter")   # into editor
    t.send("i")
    t.send(content)
    t.send("^Escape")
    t.send("^C-s")
    time.sleep(0.4)
    t.send("^C-h")
    time.sleep(0.3)
    print("--- after content", title)
    print(t.cap())

t.kill()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Helper for editor-area exploration: seed a DB with known content, drive editor."""
import os, sys, shutil, sqlite3, subprocess, time, argparse

TPL = "/tmp/ed_tpl/entries.db"
EXE = "/workspace/executable"

DEFAULT_CONTENT = "alpha beta gamma\nsecond line here\n\tTABBED line\nfourth\nfifth line\n"


def sh(*a, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(a, capture_output=True, text=True, **kw)


def make_home(name, content=DEFAULT_CONTENT, title="T1", config=None, extra=None):
    home = f"/tmp/h_{name}"
    if os.path.isdir(home):
        shutil.rmtree(home)
    os.makedirs(home + "/tui-journal", exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy(TPL, home + "/tui-journal/entries.db")
    c = sqlite3.connect(home + "/tui-journal/entries.db")
    c.execute("update entries set content=?, title=? where id=1", (content, title))
    if extra:
        for i, (t, ct) in enumerate(extra, start=2):
            c.execute("insert into entries (id,title,date,content) values (?,?,?,?)",
                      (i, t, "2026-08-%02dT00:00:00+00:00" % min(i, 28), ct))
    c.commit(); c.close()
    if config is not None:
        os.makedirs(home + "/.config/tui-journal", exist_ok=True)
        open(home + "/.config/tui-journal/config.toml", "w").write(config)
    return home


class Ed:
    def __init__(self, name, content=DEFAULT_CONTENT, cols=80, rows=16, config=None,
                 env=None, args="", extra=None, color=True, home=None):
        self.sess = name
        self.home = home or make_home(name, content=content, config=config, extra=extra)
        sh("tmux", "kill-session", "-t", self.sess)
        e = {"HOME": self.home, "TERM": "xterm-256color"}
        if env:
            e.update(env)
        parts = ["env"]
        if color:
            parts += ["-u", "NO_COLOR"]
        parts += [f"{k}={v!r}" for k, v in e.items()]
        cmd = " ".join(parts) + f" {EXE} {args}; echo __TJEXIT_$?__; sleep 600"
        sh("tmux", "new-session", "-d", "-s", self.sess, "-x", str(cols), "-y", str(rows), cmd)
        time.sleep(1.0)

    def send(self, k, delay=0.25):
        if k.startswith("^"):
            sh("tmux", "send-keys", "-t", self.sess, k[1:])
        else:
            sh("tmux", "send-keys", "-t", self.sess, "-l", k)
        time.sleep(delay)

    def keys(self, *ks, delay=0.25):
        for k in ks:
            self.send(k, delay)

    def cap(self, esc=False, n=None):
        a = ["tmux", "capture-pane", "-p", "-t", self.sess]
        if esc:
            a.insert(2, "-e")
        s = sh(*a).stdout.rstrip("\n")
        if n:
            s = "\n".join(s.split("\n")[:n])
        return s

    def show(self, tag="", esc=False, n=None):
        print(f"===== {tag} =====")
        print(self.cap(esc=esc, n=n))

    def db(self, eid=1):
        c = sqlite3.connect(self.home + "/tui-journal/entries.db")
        r = c.execute("select content from entries where id=?", (eid,)).fetchone()
        c.close()
        return r[0] if r else None

    def kill(self):
        sh("tmux", "kill-session", "-t", self.sess)


def content_pane(cap, left=30):
    """extract the content pane text lines from a plain capture"""
    out = []
    for line in cap.split("\n"):
        i = line.find("││")
        if i >= 0:
            out.append(line[i + 2:].rstrip("│").rstrip())
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--cols", type=int, default=80)
    ap.add_argument("--rows", type=int, default=16)
    ap.add_argument("--content", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--config", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--env", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--nocolor", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--args", default="")
    ap.add_argument("keys", nargs="*")
    o = ap.parse_args()
    env = dict(kv.split("=", 1) for kv in o.env.split(",")) if o.env else None
    ct = (o.content.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\t", "\t")
          if o.content is not None else DEFAULT_CONTENT)
    t = Ed(o.name, content=ct, cols=o.cols, rows=o.rows, config=o.config, env=env,
           args=o.args, color=not o.nocolor)
    n = 0
    for k in o.keys:
        if k in ("@cap", "@capE"):
            n += 1
            t.show(f"CAP {n}", esc=(k == "@capE"))
        elif k.startswith("@s"):
            time.sleep(float(k[2:]))
        else:
            t.send(k)
    t.show("FINAL")
    print("----- DB CONTENT (repr) -----")
    print(repr(t.db()))
    if not o.keep:
        t.kill()
